theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (R θ : ℝ), Continuous f → tsupport f ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → 0 < θ → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ HasCompactSupport g ∧ tsupport g ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) (R + 1) ∧ ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ θ
